literature.headline_zh: 埃博拉病毒类群本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期埃博拉病毒类群研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 截至 8 月 22 日,刚果民主共和国已报告 6 个省 57 个卫生区的 5514 例确诊病例和 2642 例死亡,成为刚果民主共和国有记录的最大病例数,也是确诊病例数第二大的埃博拉病例数。BDBV 特异性诊断、治疗和暴露后预防试验以及 疫苗 研究扩大,但尚无 疫苗 或病毒特异性 治疗 证明临床疗效。流行病控制需要完整的接触者追踪,辅以积极的病例发现、早期转诊、高质量的支持性护理、卫生工作者保护、社区参与、灵活的融资和保留基本卫生服务。 [10.1016/j.cmi.2026.10.042]
MDA 主要由训练有素的社区卫生工作者挨家挨户提供,并于 2022 年底在受影响最严重的县的卫生机构进行固定地点分发,使用双氢青蒿素-哌喹,并在计划文件和参与者账户中进行了描述。 [10.1186/s12889-026-30513-7]

Zotatifin 在低纳摩尔浓度下可抑制埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、苏丹病毒、塔伊森林病毒和本迪布焦病毒的复制。在体外,它以 6.25 nM 的浓度抑制 EBOV、TAFV、SUDV、MARV 和 BDBV 复制,EBOV、MARV 和 BDBV 的 IC50 和 IC90 值为 1.0–3.5 nM。药代动力学模型表明,在 540,000 名虚拟受试者中,皮下注射佐他替芬方案可以在≥50%的给药间隔内将浓度维持在 BDBV IC90 以上。 [10.64898/2026.11.18.767653]
在 215 名参与者中,22 名是医生,193 名是辅助医疗专业人员。据报告,有 133 名参与者参加了 IPC 培训,其中男性比女性更有可能参加。医院的医务人员报告的培训天数比卫生中心的医务人员要多。最常提到的健康信息来源是社交媒体和电视和广播。 [10.1186/s13756-026-01862-0]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: BDBV seropositivity increased from 8% at baseline to 67% at D21, declining to 34% at M6. Median NT50 titers were significantly lower for BDBV than for EBOV at D21 (40.9 vs 244.1; P<0.001) and at M6 (<20 vs 66.5; P<0.001). [10.64898/2026.11.23.26368389]

By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count. [10.1016/j.cmi.2026.10.042]

The MDA, delivered primarily door-to-door by trained community health workers with some fixed-site distribution at health facilities in the most affected sub-counties in late 2022, used dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine and was described from programme documents and participant accounts. [10.1186/s12889-026-30513-7]

Poisson regression demonstrated a significant increase in outbreak occurrence over time (incidence rate ratio [IRR] = 1.04, 95% CI: 1.02–1.07, p < 0.001), corresponding to an estimated 48% increase in outbreak frequency per decade. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11436068/v1]

Zotatifin inhibited the replication of Ebola, Marburg, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Bundibugyo viruses at low-nanomolar concentrations. In vitro, it suppressed EBOV, TAFV, SUDV, MARV, and BDBV replication at 6.25 nM, with IC50 and IC90 values of 1.0–3.5 nM for EBOV, MARV, and BDBV. [10.64898/2026.11.18.767653]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期埃博拉病毒类群研究集中呈现以下进展。
BDBV 血清阳性率从基线时的 8% 上升至 D21 时的 67%,M6 时下降至 34%。在第 21 天(40.9 vs 244.1;P<0.001)和 M6(<20 vs 66.5;P<0.001),BDBV 的中位 NT50 滴度显着低于 EBOV。

截至 8 月 22 日,刚果民主共和国已报告 6 个省 57 个卫生区的 5514 例确诊病例和 2642 例死亡,成为刚果民主共和国有记录的最大病例数,也是确诊病例数第二大的埃博拉病例数。BDBV 特异性诊断、治疗和暴露后预防试验以及 疫苗 研究扩大,但尚无 疫苗 或病毒特异性 治疗 证明临床疗效。流行病控制需要完整的接触者追踪,辅以积极的病例发现、早期转诊、高质量的支持性护理、卫生工作者保护、社区参与、灵活的融资和保留基本卫生服务。
MDA 主要由训练有素的社区卫生工作者挨家挨户提供,并于 2022 年底在受影响最严重的县的卫生机构进行固定地点分发,使用双氢青蒿素-哌喹,并在计划文件和参与者账户中进行了描述。 [10.1186/s12889-026-30513-7]。

Zotatifin 在低纳摩尔浓度下可抑制埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、苏丹病毒、塔伊森林病毒和本迪布焦病毒的复制。在体外,它以 6.25 nM 的浓度抑制 EBOV、TAFV、SUDV、MARV 和 BDBV 复制,EBOV、MARV 和 BDBV 的 IC50 和 IC90 值为 1.0–3.5 nM。药代动力学模型表明,在 540,000 名虚拟受试者中,皮下注射佐他替芬方案可以在≥50%的给药间隔内将浓度维持在 BDBV IC90 以上。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.

BDBV seropositivity increased from 8% at baseline to 67% at D21, declining to 34% at M6. Median NT50 titers were significantly lower for BDBV than for EBOV at D21 (40.9 vs 244.1; P<0.001) and at M6 (<20 vs 66.5; P<0.001).

By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count.

The MDA, delivered primarily door-to-door by trained community health workers with some fixed-site distribution at health facilities in the most affected sub-counties in late 2022, used dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine and was described from programme documents and participant accounts.

Poisson regression demonstrated a significant increase in outbreak occurrence over time (incidence rate ratio [IRR] = 1.04, 95% CI: 1.02–1.07, p < 0.001), corresponding to an estimated 48% increase in outbreak frequency per decade.

literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. BDBV seropositivity increased from 8% at baseline to 67% at D21, declining to 34% at M6. Median NT50 titers were significantly lower for BDBV than for EBOV at D21 (40.9 vs 244.1; P<0.001) and at M6 (<20 vs 66.5; P<0.001). By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count. key_findings_zh: 由本迪布焦病毒引起的埃博拉病 - 刚果民主共和国、肯尼亚和尼日利亚 - 世界卫生组织 (WHO)。 [news-6adffe8232c54d60]
IOM 支持的 监测 在报告期内发现了 39 个警报,其中 28 个发生在刚果民主共和国,1 个发生在乌干达,10 个发生在中非共和国。流离失所地点报告了 1 例本迪布焦 埃博拉病毒病 (BVD) 确诊病例,并拦截了 5 名死者,并将其送往刚果民主共和国进行样本采集和安全埋葬。 [news-8bb5066210670586]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Ebola viruses news developments.
key_findings_en: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus- Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya and Nigeria - World Health Organization (WHO). [news-6adffe8232c54d60]

IOM-supported surveillance identified 39 alerts during the reporting period, including 28 in DRC, 1 in Uganda, and 10 in CAR. One confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BVD) case was reported in a displacement site, and five deceased persons were intercepted and referred for sample collection and safe burial in DRC. [news-8bb5066210670586]
South Sudan strengthens readiness for Bundibugyo virus disease, reported by WHO | Regional Office for Africa. [news-dfba99909a1bde6a]

South Sudan strengthened its readiness for a potential Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak, following the DRC outbreak declaration and through simulation exercises and assessments. [news-9491adeb7bf56158]

A structured clinical review documents that Bundibugyo virus disease primarily presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal condition rather than a haemorrhagic fever in outbreak settings. [news-d1972f18e0511e97]

papers.title: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda at day 100: an ESCMID Emerging Infections Subcommittee update.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has challenged epidemic control despite rapid expansion of response capacity. OBJECTIVES: To reassess the threats identified by the ESCMID Emerging Infections Subcommittee at day 100 and identify clinical and public-health priorities. SOURCES: This narrative update draws on published literature and WHO, Africa CDC, ECDC, and national public health reports, using 22 August 2026 as the day-100 analytical cut-off, with data through 20 October for a subsequent update. CONTENT: By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count. Uganda contained 20 cases, and its outbreak was declared over on 27 August. By 20 October, the DRC had reported 9704 cases and 4687 deaths in 66 health zones across eight provinces; Kenya had reported nine epidemiologically linked cases and Nigeria one. Contact follow-up improved, but many transmission chains remained unidentified. BDBV-specific diagnostics, therapeutic and post-exposure prophylaxis trials, and vaccine studies expanded, yet no vaccine or virus-specific treatment had demonstrated clinical efficacy. Cross-reactive antibody responses after licensed Ebola vaccination do not establish protection against BDBV. ECDC assessed infection likelihood for EU/EEA residents as very low. IMPLICATIONS: Epidemic control requires complete contact tracing complemented by active case-finding, earlier referral, high-quality supportive care, health-worker protection, community engagement, flexible financing and preservation of essential health services.
authors: European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases
papers.journal: Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases

analysis.scope_and_question: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has challenged epidemic control despite rapid expansion of response capacity. The review aims to reassess the threats identified by the ESCMID Emerging Infections Subcommittee at day 100 and identify clinical and public-health priorities.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This narrative update draws on published literature and WHO, Africa CDC, ECDC, and national public health reports, using 22 August 2026 as the day-100 analytical cut-off, with data through 20 October for a subsequent update. Contact follow-up improved, but many transmission chains remained unidentified.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count. BDBV-specific diagnostics, therapeutic and post-exposure prophylaxis trials, and vaccine studies expanded, yet no vaccine or virus-specific treatment had demonstrated clinical efficacy. Epidemic control requires complete contact tracing complemented by active case-finding, earlier referral, high-quality supportive care, health-worker protection, community engagement, flexible financing and preservation of essential health services.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that cross-reactive antibody responses after licensed Ebola vaccination do not establish protection against BDBV. The ECDC assessed infection likelihood for EU/EEA residents as very low. The supplied evidence does not report on the effectiveness of cross-reactive antibody responses against BDBV or the specific mechanisms of transmission.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for BDBV-specific diagnostics, therapeutic and post-exposure prophylaxis trials, and vaccine studies. It also emphasizes the importance of complete contact tracing, active case-finding, earlier referral, high-quality supportive care, health-worker protection, community engagement, flexible financing and preservation of essential health services for epidemic control.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, assessing its impact and identifying clinical and public-health priorities. By 22 August 2026, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths, marking the largest recorded outbreak in the country. Despite expanded research efforts, no vaccine or virus-specific treatment had demonstrated clinical efficacy. The review underscores the need for improved contact tracing, active case-finding, and supportive care. It also notes that cross-reactive antibody responses from Ebola vaccination do not provide protection against BDBV. The ECDC assessed the infection likelihood for EU/EEA residents as very low. The review highlights the importance of maintaining essential health services and community engagement during outbreaks.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has challenged epidemic control despite rapid expansion of response capacity. OBJECTIVES: To reassess the threats identified by the ESCMID Emerging Infections Subcommittee at day 100 and identify clinical and public-health priorities. SOURCES: This narrative update draws on published literature and WHO, Africa CDC, ECDC, and national public health reports, using 22 August 2026 as the day-100 analytical cut-off, with data through 20 October for a subsequent update. CONTENT: By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count. Uganda contained 20 cases, and its outbreak was declared over on 27 August. By 20 October, the DRC had reported 9704 cases and 4687 deaths in 66 health zones across eight provinces; Kenya had reported nine epidemiologically linked cases and Nigeria one. Contact follow-up improved, but many transmission chains remained unidentified. BDBV-specific diagnostics, therapeutic and post-exposure prophylaxis trials, and vaccine studies expanded, yet no vaccine or virus-specific treatment had demonstrated clinical efficacy. Cross-reactive antibody responses after licensed Ebola vaccination do not establish protection against BDBV. ECDC assessed infection likelihood for EU/EEA residents as very low. IMPLICATIONS: Epidemic control requires complete contact tracing complemented by active case-finding, earlier referral, high-quality supportive care, health-worker protection, community engagement, flexible financing and preservation of essential health services.

papers.title: Bundibugyo virus disease in outbreak settings: A practical clinical review
papers.abstract: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) is a severe filovirus infection caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), an orthoebolavirus with diagnostic and countermeasure implications distinct from Ebola virus (EBOV). The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded substantially, with 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths reported across 63 health zones in seven provinces as of 23 September 2026. BVD usually presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness; haemorrhagic manifestations are uncommon at presentation. Early outbreak investigation also showed that EBOV-oriented testing can fail to detect BDBV, making species-appropriate molecular testing essential when BDBV is epidemiologically plausible. Supportive care remains the standard of management, but what can be delivered safely differs between peripheral facilities and dedicated filovirus treatment centres. First-contact facilities should prioritise recognition, separation, protected sampling, treatment of immediately life-threatening or common treatable conditions, and early referral; treatment centres can provide closer monitoring, advanced supportive care, and access to approved research protocols. Insecurity, displacement, laboratory and transport constraints, and delayed presentation continue to limit implementation. No vaccine or specific therapeutic has established clinical efficacy against BDBV in humans; Ervebo is being evaluated within research protocols and the PARTNERS trial is evaluating MBP134 and remdesivir-based regimens. This review synthesises historical and current evidence on recognition, diagnosis, clinical care, infection prevention, referral, and emerging countermeasures in outbreak-affected settings.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a severe filovirus infection caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), which is an orthoebolavirus distinct from Ebola virus (EBOV). The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths as of 23 September 2026. BVD typically presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness, with haemorrhagic manifestations being rare at onset. The review highlights that EBOV-oriented testing may not detect BDBV, emphasizing the need for species-specific molecular testing in epidemiologically plausible scenarios. Supportive care remains the standard of management, but the availability of safe interventions varies between peripheral facilities and dedicated filovirus treatment centres. First-contact facilities should prioritize early recognition, separation, protected sampling, and referral, while treatment centres can offer advanced supportive care and access to research protocols. Challenges such as insecurity, displacement, and logistical constraints continue to hinder effective implementation. No vaccine or specific therapy has demonstrated clinical efficacy against BDBV in humans, with Ervebo and remdesivir-based regimens under evaluation.

papers.title_zh: 暴发 环境中的本迪布焦病毒病:实用临床回顾
papers.source_body_en: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) is a severe filovirus infection caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), an orthoebolavirus with diagnostic and countermeasure implications distinct from Ebola virus (EBOV). The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded substantially, with 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths reported across 63 health zones in seven provinces as of 23 September 2026. BVD usually presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness; haemorrhagic manifestations are uncommon at presentation. Early outbreak investigation also showed that EBOV-oriented testing can fail to detect BDBV, making species-appropriate molecular testing essential when BDBV is epidemiologically plausible. Supportive care remains the standard of management, but what can be delivered safely differs between peripheral facilities and dedicated filovirus treatment centres. First-contact facilities should prioritise recognition, separation, protected sampling, treatment of immediately life-threatening or common treatable conditions, and early referral; treatment centres can provide closer monitoring, advanced supportive care, and access to approved research protocols. Insecurity, displacement, laboratory and transport constraints, and delayed presentation continue to limit implementation. No vaccine or specific therapeutic has established clinical efficacy against BDBV in humans; Ervebo is being evaluated within research protocols and the PARTNERS trial is evaluating MBP134 and remdesivir-based regimens. This review synthesises historical and current evidence on recognition, diagnosis, clinical care, infection prevention, referral, and emerging countermeasures in outbreak-affected settings.

papers.title: Cross-neutralization of Bundibugyo virus following Ebola virus booster vaccination
papers.abstract: Background: The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) highlights the absence of a licensed Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) vaccine. Ebola virus (EBOV) vaccines can induce cross-reactive BDBV binding antibodies, but evidence of cross-neutralizing antibodies is limited. Methods: In the EBO-BOOST trial ( NCT06126822 ), previously EBOV-vaccinated adults received an ERVEBO booster after primary vaccination with ERVEBO (E|E, n=60) or ZABDENO/MVABEA (Zm|E, n=40). Neutralizing antibodies against EBOV and BDBV were measured at baseline, day 21 (D21) and month 6 (M6) using biologically contained EBOV-dVP30-eGFP and BDBV-dVP30-eGFP reporter viruses. Results: BDBV seropositivity increased from 8% at baseline to 67% at D21, declining to 34% at M6. Median NT50 titers were significantly lower for BDBV than for EBOV at D21 (40.9 vs 244.1; P<0.001) and at M6 (<20 vs 66.5; P<0.001). In mixed-effects models adjusted for time since primary vaccination, BDBV responses were 65% lower than EBOV responses at D21 (GMR 0.35; 95% CI 0.26-0.48) and 50% lower at M6 (GMR 0.50; 95% CI 0.40-0.63). The Zm|E group showed a higher BDBV fold change from baseline at D21 than the E|E group (GMR 1.75; p=0.023). Conclusions: An ERVEBO booster induces BDBV cross-neutralizing antibodies in most recipients, but responses are lower than against EBOV and largely wane by 6 months. Although protective significance and correlates of protection remain to be established, these findings support evaluation of ERVEBO in parallel with BDBV-specific vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the cross-neutralization of Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) following an Ebola virus (EBOV) booster vaccination. The ongoing BVD outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) underscores the need for a BDBV vaccine, as current EBOV vaccines may induce cross-reactive antibodies. The EBO-BOOST trial evaluated previously EBOV-vaccinated adults who received an ERVEBO booster after primary vaccination with ERVEBO or ZABDENO/MVABEA. papers.title: Five Decades of Ebola Virus Disease in Africa (1976–2026): Exploring Outbreak Trends, Mortality Patterns, Transmission, and Epidemiological Dynamics—A Retrospective Study
papers.abstract: Background Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains one of the most severe viral hemorrhagic fevers affecting Africa, causing recurrent outbreaks with substantial morbidity, mortality, and socioeconomic disruption. Despite five decades of documented outbreaks, comprehensive assessments of long-term epidemiological trends across the continent remain limited. This study investigated outbreak trends, mortality patterns, and epidemiological dynamics of EVD in Africa from 1976 to 2026. Methods A retrospective epidemiological analysis of publicly available WHO, CDC, and other credible surveillance and scientific data was conducted to characterize Ebola outbreaks by year, country, region, virus species, duration, cases, deaths, and case fatality rate (CFR). Descriptive statistics, Kruskal–Wallis tests, Mann–Kendall trend analysis, Sen’s slope estimation, and Poisson regression were used to assess outbreak characteristics, temporal trends, and changes in annual outbreak frequency. Results A total of 41 human EVD outbreaks were identified across Africa between 1976 and 2026, with outbreak frequency increasing progressively from three outbreaks during 1976–1986 to fourteen outbreaks during 2017–2026. Poisson regression demonstrated a significant increase in outbreak occurrence over time (incidence rate ratio [IRR] = 1.04, 95% CI: 1.02–1.07, p < 0.001), corresponding to an estimated 48% increase in outbreak frequency per decade. papers.title: Targeting host eIF4A with zotatifin inhibits Bundibugyo virus and other filoviruses
papers.abstract: Abstract Filoviruses, including Ebola and Marburg viruses, depend on host eIF4A helicase activity for replication. Zotatifin is a first-in-class, clinical-stage eIF4A inhibitor that acts as a molecular glue, stabilizing the interaction between eIF4A and selected polypurine-rich RNA sequences, thereby inhibiting RNA unwinding and ribosomal scanning. Here, we identify pronounced polypurine enrichment in the 5′ untranslated regions (5′ UTRs) of the seven major filoviral protein-coding genes NP, VP35, VP40, GP, VP30, VP24, and L across four virus species, including Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). Consistent with these findings, zotatifin inhibits the replication of Ebola, Marburg, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Bundibugyo viruses at low-nanomolar concentrations. Zotatifin has been administered to humans in oncology and COVID-19 clinical studies. Clinical pharmacokinetic–pharmacodynamic (PK–PD) modeling indicates that exposures resulting in inhibition of BDBV replication are achievable in humans at tolerated doses following subcutaneous administration. Together, these findings support the repurposing of zotatifin as a host-directed antiviral candidate against BDBV and other filoviruses, with potential applications in preparedness for future outbreaks. Highlights Zotatifin targets host eIF4A to inhibit filovirus replication. Conserved polypurine-rich motifs in filoviral 5′ UTRs are putative sites for zotatifin-induced eIF4A clamping. Zotatifin suppresses EBOV, TAFV, SUDV, MARV and BDBV replication at 6.25 nM in vitro, with IC50 and IC90 values of 1.0–3.5 nM for EBOV, MARV and BDBV. Monte Carlo simulation with a population PK model built from COVID-19 patient data identified subcutaneous zotatifin regimens that keep concentrations above the BDBV IC 90 for ≥50% of the dosing interval in 540,000 virtual pediatric and adult subjects. Predicted exposures for these regimens fall within those achieved with subcutaneous doses tolerated in patients with COVID-19.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Filoviruses, including Ebola and Marburg viruses, depend on host eIF4A helicase activity for replication. This study aimed to identify potential targets for antiviral intervention by examining the interaction between eIF4A and filoviral RNA sequences.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed the 5′ untranslated regions (5′ UTRs) of seven major filoviral protein-coding genes across four virus species, including Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). It also evaluated the antiviral effects of zotatifin against multiple filoviruses in vitro and used pharmacokinetic modeling to assess its potential in humans.
analysis.methods: The researchers identified polypurine-rich sequences in the 5′ UTRs of filoviral genes and tested zotatifin's ability to inhibit RNA unwinding and ribosomal scanning. They conducted in vitro experiments to measure antiviral activity and used Monte Carlo simulations with a population pharmacokinetic model to predict human exposures.
analysis.main_results: Zotatifin inhibited the replication of Ebola, Marburg, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Bundibugyo viruses at low-nanomolar concentrations. In vitro, it suppressed EBOV, TAFV, SUDV, MARV, and BDBV replication at 6.25 nM, with IC50 and IC90 values of 1.0–3.5 nM for EBOV, MARV, and BDBV. Pharmacokinetic modeling showed that subcutaneous zotatifin regimens could maintain concentrations above the BDBV IC90 for ≥50% of the dosing interval in 540,000 virtual subjects.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that zotatifin's mechanism of action, targeting host eIF4A, is effective against multiple filoviruses, including BDBV. This supports its potential as a host-directed antiviral candidate for future outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide a foundation for repurposing zotatifin as a therapeutic option against BDBV and other filoviruses, enhancing preparedness for outbreaks and offering a novel strategy for antiviral development.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on in vitro data and pharmacokinetic modeling, which may not fully reflect in vivo conditions. However, the evidence is strong, with consistent results across multiple filoviruses and achievable human exposures based on tolerated doses.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of zotatifin, a host-directed eIF4A inhibitor, as an antiviral against filoviruses, including Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). It identifies polypurine-rich sequences in the 5′ UTRs of filoviral genes and demonstrates that zotatifin inhibits replication at low-nanomolar concentrations. In vitro experiments show suppression of EBOV, TAFV, SUDV, MARV, and BDBV replication, with IC50 and IC90 values of 1.0–3.5 nM. Pharmacokinetic modeling suggests that subcutaneous zotatifin regimens could maintain concentrations above the BDBV IC90 for ≥50% of the dosing interval in a large virtual population. These findings support the repurposing of zotatifin as a candidate for treating BDBV and other filoviruses, offering a novel approach for outbreak preparedness. The study's reliance on in vitro and modeling data limits its direct applicability to human settings, but the evidence is robust and consistent across multiple filoviruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 丝状病毒,包括埃博拉病毒和马尔堡病毒,依赖于 宿主 eIF4A 解旋酶活性进行复制。本研究旨在通过检查 eIF4A 和丝状病毒 RNA 序列之间的相互作用来确定 抗病毒药物 干预的潜在靶点。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了包括本迪布焦病毒 (BDBV) 在内的四种病毒物种的 7 个主要丝状病毒蛋白编码基因的 5' 非翻译区 (5' UTR)。它还在体外评估了 Zotatifin 对多种丝状病毒的 抗病毒药物 作用,并使用药代动力学模型评估其在人类中的潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在丝状病毒基因的 5' UTR 中鉴定出富含多嘌呤的序列,并测试了佐他芬抑制 RNA 解旋和核糖体扫描的能力。他们进行了体外实验来测量 抗病毒药物 活性,并使用蒙特卡罗模拟和群体药代动力学模型来预测人类暴露情况。
elements_zh.main_results: Zotatifin 在低纳摩尔浓度下可抑制埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、苏丹病毒、塔伊森林病毒和本迪布焦病毒的复制。在体外,它以 6.25 nM 的浓度抑制 EBOV、TAFV、SUDV、MARV 和 BDBV 复制,EBOV、MARV 和 BDBV 的 IC50 和 IC90 值为 1.0–3.5 nM。药代动力学模型表明,在 540,000 名虚拟受试者中,皮下注射佐他替芬方案可以在≥50%的给药间隔内将浓度维持在 BDBV IC90 以上。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,zotatifin 的作用机制是针对 宿主 eIF4A,可有效对抗多种丝状病毒,包括 BDBV。这支持了其作为未来 暴发 的 宿主 定向 抗病毒药物 候选者的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为重新利用佐他替芬作为针对 BDBV 和其他丝状病毒的治疗选择奠定了基础,增强了 暴发 的准备并为 抗病毒药物 的开发提供了新的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于体外数据和药代动力学模型,可能无法完全反映体内条件。然而,证据是强有力的,多种丝状病毒和基于耐受剂量的可达到的人体暴露结果一致。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 丝状病毒,包括埃博拉病毒和马尔堡病毒,依赖于 宿主 eIF4A 解旋酶活性进行复制。本研究旨在通过检查 eIF4A 和丝状病毒 RNA 序列之间的相互作用来确定 抗病毒药物 干预的潜在靶点。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了包括本迪布焦病毒 (BDBV) 在内的四种病毒物种的 7 个主要丝状病毒蛋白编码基因的 5' 非翻译区 (5' UTR)。它还在体外评估了 Zotatifin 对多种丝状病毒的 抗病毒药物 作用,并使用药代动力学模型评估其在人类中的潜力。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员在丝状病毒基因的 5' UTR 中鉴定出富含多嘌呤的序列,并测试了佐他芬抑制 RNA 解旋和核糖体扫描的能力。他们进行了体外实验来测量 抗病毒药物 活性,并使用蒙特卡罗模拟和群体药代动力学模型来预测人类暴露情况。
analysis_zh.main_results: Zotatifin 在低纳摩尔浓度下可抑制埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、苏丹病毒、塔伊森林病毒和本迪布焦病毒的复制。在体外,它以 6.25 nM 的浓度抑制 EBOV、TAFV、SUDV、MARV 和 BDBV 复制,EBOV、MARV 和 BDBV 的 IC50 和 IC90 值为 1.0–3.5 nM。药代动力学模型表明,在 540,000 名虚拟受试者中,皮下注射佐他替芬方案可以在≥50%的给药间隔内将浓度维持在 BDBV IC90 以上。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,zotatifin 的作用机制是针对 宿主 eIF4A,可有效对抗多种丝状病毒,包括 BDBV。这支持了其作为未来 暴发 的 宿主 定向 抗病毒药物 候选者的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为重新利用佐他替芬作为针对 BDBV 和其他丝状病毒的治疗选择奠定了基础,增强了 暴发 的准备并为 抗病毒药物 的开发提供了新的策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于体外数据和药代动力学模型,可能无法完全反映体内条件。然而,证据是强有力的,多种丝状病毒和基于耐受剂量的可达到的人体暴露结果一致。

papers.title: Ervebo Vaccine Provides Cross-Protection Against Bundibugyo Virus Infection in Macaques
papers.abstract: Abstract The 2026 Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was declared a public health emergency (PHEIC) in May 2026 (1). Regional security concerns, debilitated medical infrastructure, diagnostic limitations, and lack of approved BDBV–specific medical countermeasures have contributed to rapid escalation of the outbreak (2). Currently, there are no licensed medical countermeasures for BDBV (3). Several BDBV-specific vaccines are in development (4), including a vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV)–based vaccine expressing the BDBV glycoprotein which has demonstrated strong preclinical efficacy (5-7); however, these candidates have not yet completed clinical evaluation. A licensed VSV-based vaccine expressing the Ebola virus glycoprotein (VSV-EBOV) (8) is available for human use and clinical (ERVEBO) and research grade (VSV-EBOV) material has been shown to elicit cross-reactive, cross-neutralizing and inconclusive cross-protective immune responses against the related BDBV (5,9-14). ERVEBO’s protective efficacy against BDBV, however, has not been formally established in the standard macaque model of BDBV infection. Macaques received a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine and were challenged with BDBV 14 days after vaccination. ERVEBO vaccinated macaques exhibited significantly reduced clinical disease and strikingly increased survival, as well as significantly reduced viremia, mucosal viral shedding and disease-associated biochemistry markers consistent with protection against BDBV-mediated hepatorenal disease. These findings indicate that ERVEBO can rapidly mediate cross-protective immunity against BDBV.

papers.title: Knowledge, self-estimated risks and training participation surrounding infection prevention and control of COVID-19 and Ebola Disease among healthcare workers in Rwanda: a cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Rwanda has not only been affected by the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic and a Marburg Disease (MARD) outbreak in 2024 but is also regularly confronted with outbreaks of Ebola Disease (EBOD) in neighboring countries. To better target preparedness activities, this study aimed to assess infection prevention and control (IPC) and clinical competence of health care workers (HCW) in five districts of Rwanda. METHODS: In this cross-sectional study, 215 HCWs in 26 health centers and eight hospitals in Kigali and the districts Rubavu and Nyamagabe were selected by multistage sampling and answered a questionnaire containing 84 items about clinical and IPC-related aspects of COVID-19 and EBOD. We assessed HCW knowledge as weighted scores (proportion of achieved points), and analyzed self-estimated risk, training participation and associations with demographic and occupational factors. RESULTS: Of 215 participants, 22 (10.2%) were physicians and 193 (89.8%) paramedical professionals, 133 (61.9%) employed in district hospitals and 82 (38.1%) in health centers. Participation in IPC trainings was reported by 133 (61.9%) participants, more frequently by males (48/65, 73.8%) than females (85/150, 56.7%; adjusted Prevalence Ratio (aPR) 1.31, 95%CI 1.07-1.61). HCWs in hospitals reported higher amount of training days than HCWs in health centers (p = 0.001). Most frequently mentioned sources for health information were social media (29%) and TV & Radio (27%). Participants achieved a mean total knowledge score of 61.1% (SD 7.16), with higher results in Kigali (62.4%, SD 7.1), for COVID-19-related questions (62.5%, SD 8.2) and for questions on practical IPC implementation (75.6%, SD 10.4), p < 0.001. Regarding COVID-19, 182 (84.7%) rated their IPC knowledge as good or very good while only 95 (44.2%) stated this for EBOD. Self-assessed ability to avoid infection was perceived "possible" or "very well possible" by 172 (80%) regarding SARS-CoV and 123 (57.2%) regarding EBOD. CONCLUSION: HCWs showed overall moderate to good knowledge, independently from demographic and professional factors. Higher scores regarding practical IPC implementation vs. additional medical knowledge and more recent vs. past clinical experiences underline the need of regular refresher trainings. Health information activities should use digital channels in the future and promote gender equity in access to training.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估卢旺达医护人员 (HCW) 的感染预防和控制 (IPC) 和临床能力,以便根据该国应对 COVID-19 大流行和埃博拉病 (EBOD) 暴发 的经验,更好地开展准备活动。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对卢旺达五个地区(包括基加利、鲁巴武和尼亚加贝)26 个卫生中心和 8 家医院的 215 名医护人员进行了一项横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用多阶段抽样来选择参与者,他们完成了一份包含 84 个有关 COVID-19 和 EBOD 临床和 IPC 相关方面的项目的调查问卷。知识被评估为基于所获得分数的加权分数。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 215 名参与者中,22 名是医生,193 名是辅助医疗专业人员。据报告,有 133 名参与者参加了 IPC 培训,其中男性比女性更有可能参加。医院的医务人员报告的培训天数比卫生中心的医务人员要多。最常提到的健康信息来源是社交媒体和电视和广播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了定期进修培训的必要性,并建议应更多地利用数字渠道传播健康信息,以促进培​​训机会中的性别平等。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为有针对性的 IPC 培训计划提供了信息,并表明使用数字平台对医护人员进行健康教育的重要性,特别是解决培训参与方面的性别差异。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横断面设计和潜在的自我报告偏差而受到限制,但由于直接观察了医护人员的培训参与和知识得分,证据强度适中。

papers.title: RNA folding drives species-dependent host mRNA partitioning in Ebola virus condensates.
papers.abstract: RNA viruses form membraneless condensates in host cells to drive replication, but whether these compartments regulate host RNAs remains unclear. Using multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization (MERFISH)-based subcellular transcriptomics, we quantified cellular mRNA recruitment into Ebola virus condensates under basal and interferon (IFN)-stimulated states. We find that, in the basal state, cellular RNAs with minimally folded coding regions are selectively recruited. Under IFN stimulation, however, IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) with structured 3' UTRs concentrate in viral condensates. We find that both RNA structural features are conserved in the viral genome and support its retention in condensates. In parallel, for cellular mRNAs, we find that partitioning into condensates prolongs RNA half-life and amplifies, rather than dampens, ISG expression. Fruit bats, which do not experience severe disease from RNA viruses, instead have ISGs with reduced 3' UTR folding and may evade condensate sequestration, thus enabling balanced antiviral responses. This selective stabilization links condensate function to RNA regulation as a molecular determinant of virus-host co-evolution and disease pathogenesis.

source_records.title: RNA folding drives species-dependent host mRNA partitioning in Ebola virus condensates.
source_records.abstract: RNA viruses form membraneless condensates in host cells to drive replication, but whether these compartments regulate host RNAs remains unclear. Using multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization (MERFISH)-based subcellular transcriptomics, we quantified cellular mRNA recruitment into Ebola virus condensates under basal and interferon (IFN)-stimulated states. We find that, in the basal state, cellular RNAs with minimally folded coding regions are selectively recruited. Under IFN stimulation, however, IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) with structured 3' UTRs concentrate in viral condensates. We find that both RNA structural features are conserved in the viral genome and support its retention in condensates. In parallel, for cellular mRNAs, we find that partitioning into condensates prolongs RNA half-life and amplifies, rather than dampens, ISG expression. Fruit bats, which do not experience severe disease from RNA viruses, instead have ISGs with reduced 3' UTR folding and may evade condensate sequestration, thus enabling balanced antiviral responses. This selective stabilization links condensate function to RNA regulation as a molecular determinant of virus-host co-evolution and disease pathogenesis.

papers.title: Perceived contributions of malaria mass drug administration to the 2022 Ebola virus disease response in Uganda: a qualitative study of implementation experiences and lessons learned
papers.abstract: In regions with a high malaria burden, overlapping symptoms, such as fever, complicate case detection, surveillance, and response to outbreaks of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). During the 2022 Ebola Sudan Virus Disease (SVD) outbreak in Uganda’s Mubende and Kassanda districts, clinically differentiating febrile illnesses proved challenging and potentially delayed Ebola case identification and increased exposure risk. This paper documents stakeholders’ perceptions of the contribution of, and the facilitators and barriers to, Mass Drug Administration (MDA) for malaria during the outbreak in Mubende and Kassanda districts, Uganda. This was a qualitative descriptive study involving 30 key informant interviews with health workers, local leaders, and implementers alongside 10 focus group discussions with community members and community health workers (CHWs). Data were transcribed, translated, and thematically analyzed. The MDA, delivered primarily door-to-door by trained community health workers with some fixed-site distribution at health facilities in the most affected sub-counties in late 2022, used dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine and was described from programme documents and participant accounts. The intervention was perceived to reduce malaria cases and deaths and to minimize syndromic overlap between malaria and Ebola, particularly in private clinics where reduced Ebola exposure was reported by study participants. Key facilitators included trained CHWs conducting house-to-house sensitization, strong partner support, and active engagement of local leaders to enhance community participation. Major barriers included public distrust of government programs and negative community perceptions of the intervention, limited drug supply, and location of some fixed distribution points near Ebola isolation facilities. Stakeholders perceived that malaria MDA contributed to reductions in malaria cases and deaths, eased the perceived differentiation of febrile illness during Ebola triage, by reducing the background burden of malaria-related fever, though it did not replace individual diagnostic testing, and supported continuity of access to malaria services during the outbreak. Implementation depended on community trust, adequate logistics, partner support, and the active involvement of CHWs and trusted community leaders. These qualitative findings do not establish the epidemiological effectiveness of MDA, but they offer operational lessons for considering malaria MDA within outbreak preparedness frameworks in high-malaria-burden settings, where its use should be guided by WHO recommendations, local epidemiology, feasibility, and safety.

papers.title_zh: 疟疾大规模药物管理对乌干达 2022 年 埃博拉病毒病 应对措施的贡献:对实施经验和教训的定性研究
papers.source_body_en: In regions with a high malaria burden, overlapping symptoms, such as fever, complicate case detection, surveillance, and response to outbreaks of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). During the 2022 Ebola Sudan Virus Disease (SVD) outbreak in Uganda’s Mubende and Kassanda districts, clinically differentiating febrile illnesses proved challenging and potentially delayed Ebola case identification and increased exposure risk. This paper documents stakeholders’ perceptions of the contribution of, and the facilitators and barriers to, Mass Drug Administration (MDA) for malaria during the outbreak in Mubende and Kassanda districts, Uganda. This was a qualitative descriptive study involving 30 key informant interviews with health workers, local leaders, and implementers alongside 10 focus group discussions with community members and community health workers (CHWs). Data were transcribed, translated, and thematically analyzed. The MDA, delivered primarily door-to-door by trained community health workers with some fixed-site distribution at health facilities in the most affected sub-counties in late 2022, used dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine and was described from programme documents and participant accounts. The intervention was perceived to reduce malaria cases and deaths and to minimize syndromic overlap between malaria and Ebola, particularly in private clinics where reduced Ebola exposure was reported by study participants. Key facilitators included trained CHWs conducting house-to-house sensitization, strong partner support, and active engagement of local leaders to enhance community participation. Major barriers included public distrust of government programs and negative community perceptions of the intervention, limited drug supply, and location of some fixed distribution points near Ebola isolation facilities. Stakeholders perceived that malaria MDA contributed to reductions in malaria cases and deaths, eased the perceived differentiation of febrile illness during Ebola triage, by reducing the background burden of malaria-related fever, though it did not replace individual diagnostic testing, and supported continuity of access to malaria services during the outbreak. Implementation depended on community trust, adequate logistics, partner support, and the active involvement of CHWs and trusted community leaders. These qualitative findings do not establish the epidemiological effectiveness of MDA, but they offer operational lessons for considering malaria MDA within outbreak preparedness frameworks in high-malaria-burden settings, where its use should be guided by WHO recommendations, local epidemiology, feasibility, and safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 在疟疾负担高的地区,症状重叠,例如发烧,病例检测、监测 以及对 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 的 暴发 的反应变得复杂。2022 年乌干达穆本德和卡桑达地区爆发苏丹埃博拉病毒病 (SVD) 暴发 期间,临床区分发热性疾病具有挑战性,可能会延迟埃博拉病例的识别并增加暴露风险。本文记录了利益相关者对乌干达穆本德和卡桑达地区 暴发 期间疟疾大众药物管理局 (MDA) 的贡献、促进因素和障碍的看法。这是一项定性描述性研究,涉及对卫生工作者、地方领导人和实施者进行 30 次关键信息访谈,以及与社区成员和社区卫生工作者 (CHW) 进行的 10 次焦点小组讨论。数据被转录、翻译并进行主题分析。MDA 主要由训练有素的社区卫生工作者挨家挨户提供,并于 2022 年底在受影响最严重的县的卫生机构进行固定地点分发,使用双氢青蒿素-哌喹,并在计划文件和参与者账户中进行了描述。该干预措施被认为可以减少疟疾病例和死亡,并最大限度地减少疟疾和埃博拉之间的症状重叠,特别是在研究参与者报告的埃博拉暴露减少的私人诊所。主要推动者包括经过培训的社区卫生工作者进行挨家挨户的宣传、强有力的合作伙伴支持以及当地领导人的积极参与以增强社区参与。主要障碍包括公众对政府计划的不信任、社区对干预措施的负面看法、药物供应有限以及埃博拉隔离设施附近的一些固定分发点。利益相关者认为,疟疾 MDA 有助于减少疟疾病例和死亡,通过减少疟疾相关发热的背景负担,缓解埃博拉分诊期间发热性疾病的感知差异,尽管它并没有取代个人诊断检测,并支持在 暴发 期间继续获得疟疾服务。实施取决于社区信任、充足的后勤、合作伙伴的支持以及社区卫生工作者和值得信赖的社区领袖的积极参与。这些定性研究结果并未确定 MDA 的流行病学有效性,但它们为在疟疾高负担地区的 暴发 防备框架内考虑疟疾 MDA 提供了操作经验,其使用应遵循 WHO 建议、当地 流行病学、可行性和安全性。

papers.title: Elucidating the Effect that Ebola Virus Matrix Protein VP40 Mutations have on Matrix Assembly and Host Cell Lipid Interactions
papers.abstract: The Ebola virus (EBOV) matrix protein, VP40, is the primary driver of viral assembly and egress, a process fundamentally dependent on its ability to traffic to the inner leaflet of the host plasma membrane (PM) and assemble into higher-order oligomers. VP40 dimerizes in the cytoplasm and will traffic to the PM, where the C-terminal domain (CTD) facilitates initial interaction, lipid binding, and higher order oligomerization required for viral budding. The interactions between the structural surfaces of VP40 as well as the key drivers behind VP40 mechanisms remain poorly understood. This thesis investigates these dynamic interactions and VP40 mechanisms by evaluating natural viral mutations from major outbreaks alongside targeted computational mutagenesis of key structural residues. First, we analyzed natural CTD mutations identified in patient samples from the 2013–2016 West African (S228G, G226R, Q245R, K256R) and 2018–2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) (D312G, K274N, S228C, and S228N)EBOV outbreaks to determine how naturally evolving viral sequences alter protein activity and host cell interactions. Mutations that increased the net positive charge (+1) of the protein (G226R, Q245R, and D312G) significantly enhanced PM localization, though this did not uniformly translate to increased virus-like particle (VLP) budding efficiency for Q245R or D312G. Conversely, serine mutations (S228C/G/N) maintained standard PM localization. Unexpectedly, the charge-decreasing mutation K274N (-1) significantly increased PM localization and trended toward higher VLP budding. These natural variants demonstrate a distinct disconnect between initial PM recruitment and the stable lipid or protein-protein interactions required for viral egress. To further elucidate dimer-dimer interactions at the PM, we studied CTD residue lysine (K) 326 using molecular dynamics simulations, computational site-saturation mutagenesis, and in vitro assays. K326 is predicted to play a critical role in stabilizing the interfaces of higher-order structures like tetramers and hexamers. Experimental mutation of this residue to alanine (K326A) or aspartic acid (K326D) significantly impaired PM localization and completely abrogated VLP production. This indicates that cationic residue at this position is crucial not only for binding anionic lipids but for forming stabilizing interactions across VP40 dimer-dimer interfaces. These findings identify K326 as a keystone residue for both membrane binding and higher-order oligomerization, while also demonstrating how natural evolutionary mutations modify VP40 activity to alter interactions with host cells.

papers.title: Implementation of Risk Communication Tabletop Exercise and Areas for Improvement: A Case Study on the Office of the Spokesperson, Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Although risk communication is essential to infectious disease crisis response, in the Republic of Korea, infectious disease crisis management exercises have mainly focused on field response procedures, with few exercises specifically addressing risk communication. This paper describes the implementation of a risk communication tabletop exercise developed and conducted by the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and presents the identified improvement tasks and implications. METHODS: The World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual (2017) was used to develop a discussion-based tabletop exercise using Ebola virus disease and avian influenza scenarios. The exercise aimed to evaluate risk communication procedures at each crisis alert level, clarify team roles and external cooperation systems, and identify improvement areas. The exercise simulated escalating crisis alert levels through a spokesperson-led communication review meeting, followed by post-exercise discussion. RESULTS: Briefing procedures, centralized press inquiry channels, misinformation and disinformation monitoring procedures, and communication channels for external cooperation operated smoothly during the exercise. In areas where standards and roles had not been sufficiently specified, ad hoc responses were observed. The exercise identified areas for improvement in emergency communication content, public campaigns, press communication, implementation of external cooperation, and personnel and organizational operations. CONCLUSIONS: Repeated peacetime exercises can strengthen risk communication. This case may provide a basis for developing evaluation frameworks, expanding participation, and promoting the standardization and institutionalization of risk communication exercises.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the implementation of risk communication tabletop exercises in the context of infectious disease crisis management, particularly in the Republic of Korea. The central question is how to improve risk communication procedures during public health emergencies, with an emphasis on the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency. The topic boundary is limited to risk communication exercises and their evaluation, with the target entities being Ebola viruses and related diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review describes a discussion-based tabletop exercise developed using the World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual (2017). It used scenarios involving Ebola virus disease and avian influenza to simulate escalating crisis alert levels. The exercise involved a spokesperson-led communication review meeting followed by post-exercise discussions. The methods included evaluating risk communication procedures at each alert level, clarifying team roles, and identifying improvement areas.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The exercise found that briefing procedures, centralized press inquiry channels, misinformation monitoring, and external cooperation communication channels operated smoothly. However, areas where standards and roles were not sufficiently specified led to ad hoc responses. The review concludes that repeated peacetime exercises can strengthen risk communication and that this case may provide a basis for developing evaluation frameworks and promoting the standardization of risk communication exercises.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while some procedures were effective, there were gaps in the specification of standards and roles, leading to ad hoc responses. It also notes that the exercise identified areas for improvement in emergency communication content, public campaigns, press communication, and organizational operations. These findings suggest a need for more detailed protocols and better coordination mechanisms.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends the development of evaluation frameworks for risk communication exercises, expanding participation in such exercises, and promoting the standardization and institutionalization of risk communication practices. It also emphasizes the importance of clarifying team roles and external cooperation systems to ensure effective and consistent communication during public health crises.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the implementation of a risk communication tabletop exercise conducted by the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency. The exercise, based on the World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual, used scenarios involving Ebola virus disease and avian influenza to simulate crisis alert levels. It identified strengths in briefing procedures, press inquiry channels, and external cooperation communication, but also highlighted gaps in role specification and standardization. The review concludes that repeated peacetime exercises can enhance risk communication and suggests the need for improved frameworks and institutionalization of these practices. Key implications include the development of evaluation tools, expanded participation, and better coordination mechanisms to address communication challenges during infectious disease outbreaks.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 此次审查的重点是在传染病危机管理背景下实施风险沟通桌面演习,特别是在韩国。核心问题是如何改进突发公共卫生事件期间的风险沟通程序,重点是韩国疾病管理和预防局发言人办公室。主题边界仅限于风险沟通练习及其评估,目标实体为埃博拉病毒及相关疾病。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论描述了使用世界卫生组织的模拟练习手册(2017 年)开发的基于讨论的桌面练习。它使用涉及 埃博拉病毒病 和禽流感的场景来模拟不断升级的危机警报级别。此次演习包括由发言人主导的沟通审查会议,以及演习后的讨论。这些方法包括评估每个警报级别的风险沟通程序、明确团队角色以及确定改进领域。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 演练发现,通报程序、新闻集中询问渠道、虚假信息监测、对外合作沟通渠道运行平稳。然而,标准和角色未充分明确的领域导致了临时响应。审查的结论是,平时反复进行演习可以加强风险沟通,该案例可以为制定评估框架和促进风险沟通演习的标准化提供基础。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查强调,虽然一些程序是有效的,但在标准和角色的规范方面存在差距,导致采取临时应对措施。它还指出,演习确定了应急通信内容、公共活动、新闻传播和组织运作方面需要改进的领域。这些发现表明需要更详细的协议和更好的协调机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查建议制定风险沟通活动评估框架,扩大风险沟通活动的参与范围,推动风险沟通实践的标准化和制度化。它还强调了明确团队角色和外部合作系统的重要性,以确保公共卫生危机期间有效和一致的沟通。

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:尽管风险沟通对于传染病危机应对至关重要,但在韩国,传染病危机管理演习主要集中在现场应对程序,很少有专门针对风险沟通的演习。本文介绍了韩国疾病控制和预防局发言人办公室开发和开展的风险沟通桌面演习的实施情况,并介绍了已确定的改进任务和影响。方法:根据世界卫生组织的模拟练习手册(2017 年),使用 埃博拉病毒病 和禽流感场景开发基于讨论的桌面练习。此次演习旨在评估每个危机警报级别的风险沟通程序,明确团队角色和外部合作体系,并确定需要改进的领域。此次演习通过发言人主导的沟通审查会议模拟了不断升级的危机警报级别,随后进行了演习后讨论。结果:演习期间通报程序、新闻集中询问渠道、错误信息和虚假信息监测程序以及对外合作沟通渠道运行顺利。在标准和作用尚未充分明确的领域,采取了临时应对措施。此次演习确定了应急通信内容、公众宣传、新闻传播、对外合作实施、人员和组织运作等方面需要改进的领域。结论:平时反复演习可以加强风险沟通。该案例可为制定评估框架、扩大参与范围、促进风险沟通活动的标准化和制度化提供依据。

papers.title: Tools without trust: public health diplomacy and the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in East Africa
papers.abstract: Public health emergencies test relationships as much as laboratories. On 15 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) confirmed an outbreak of Bundibugyo virus in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, and the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 17 May (1,2). As of 2 September 2026, the DRC epidemic had reached 6,342 confirmed cases and 3,072 confirmed deaths (2). Uganda, by contrast, had successfully interrupted transmission, and both the World Health Organization and Uganda's Ministry of Health subsequently declared the outbreak over. Nevertheless, Uganda continued to face travel-related restrictions, prompting Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya to call for their removal at the July 2026 African Union health summit (3). His argument, that countries should not be penalized for transparent reporting, names the gap this editorial addresses. We use public health diplomacy narrowly: the standing legal and institutional arrangements between neighboring states and their regional bloc that let cross-border response operate under political stress. The trust at stake is the confidence of Ministries of Health that transparent reporting will result in regional support rather than unilateral penalties. The International Health Regulations (IHR) (2005) expectation of rapid notification is not always matched by protection from its economic and political consequences. Public health diplomacy of this regional kind must be built as peacetime infrastructure, not improvised in an emergency.That gap is legal, and its consequences extend well beyond data governance. Cross-border surveillance scholarship distinguishes four interoperability dimensions on which such a response depends: technical, semantic, organizational, and legal (4). In the Bundibugyo response, East notification. Africa CDC's August 2024 mpox declaration showed that regional incentive structures 65 can reward early notification (5). Kaseya's Ghana appeal articulated the political imperative. If countries that comply with international reporting obligations continue to bear disproportionate 67 costs, the credibility of the global outbreak notification system may be eroded.

It highlights the gap in the global outbreak notification system, where rapid reporting is expected but not always matched by protection from economic and political consequences. The study shows that while the DRC faced a significant epidemic with 6,342 confirmed cases and 3,072 deaths, Uganda successfully interrupted transmission. The authors argue that transparent reporting should not result in unilateral penalties and emphasize the need for regional incentive structures to support cross-border health responses. The findings suggest that without such structures, the credibility of the global health system may be compromised. The study is based on qualitative analysis and historical data, providing a moderate assessment of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了了解突发公共卫生事件如何影响国际关系的需要以及透明报告在区域卫生外交中的重要性。作者强调了全球 暴发 通知系统的差距,该系统期望快速报告,但并不总是伴随着免受经济和政治后果的保护。

elements_zh.methods: 该研究对公共卫生外交进行定性分析,考察邻国和区域集团之间的法律和制度安排。它还引用了有关 暴发 回应的历史数据以及透明报告对国际关系的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 截至2026年9月2日,刚果民主共和国疫情已达6,342例确诊病例,3,072例确诊死亡。乌干达成功中断传播,世界卫生组织和乌干达卫生部均宣布暴发结束。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,如果遵守报告义务的国家继续承担不成比例的成本,全球 暴发 通知系统的可信度可能会受到削弱。这凸显了对公共卫生透明度的政治和经济后果的新视角。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明需要改进区域激励结构,奖励及早通知并支持透明报告,同时又不施加不成比例的处罚。这对于加强跨境卫生应对措施和对国际卫生系统的信任具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对定性分析和历史数据的依赖而受到限制,可能无法全面反映公共卫生外交的复杂性。证据是温和的,因为它是基于报告的结果和政策讨论,而不是直接的经验测量。

papers.abstract_zh: 突发公共卫生事件对人际关系的考验不亚于对实验室的考验。2026 年 5 月 15 日,刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 在伊图里省蒙布瓦卢确认了本迪布焦病毒 暴发,世界卫生组织于 5 月 17 日宣布国际关注的突发公共卫生事件 (PHEIC) (1,2)。截至 2026 年 9 月 2 日,刚果民主共和国疫情已达 6,342 例确诊病例和 3,072 例死亡病例 (2)。相比之下,乌干达成功中断了传播,世界卫生组织和乌干达卫生部随后宣布暴发结束。尽管如此,乌干达继续面临与旅行相关的限制,促使非洲疾病预防控制中心总干事让·卡塞亚 (Jean Kaseya) 在 2026 年 7 月的非洲联盟卫生峰会上呼吁取消这些限制 (3)。他的论点是,各国不应因透明报告而受到惩罚,这正是这篇社论所要解决的问题。我们狭隘地使用公共卫生外交:邻国及其区域集团之间的长期法律和制度安排,使跨境应对措施能够在政治压力下运作。所面临的信任是卫生部的信心,即透明的报告将带来区域支持而不是单方面惩罚。《国际卫生条例》(IHR)(2005)对快速通报的期望并不总是与对其经济和政治后果的保护相匹配。这种区域性的公共卫生外交必须作为和平时期的基础设施来建设,而不是在紧急情况下临时搭建。这种差距是合法的,其后果远远超出了数据治理的范围。跨境 监测 学术区分了此类响应所依赖的四个互操作性维度:技术、语义、组织和法律 (4)。在本迪布焦回应中,东通知。非洲疾病预防控制中心 2024 年 8 月的 MPOX 声明显示,区域激励结构 65 可以奖励早期通知 (5)。卡塞亚向加纳发出的呼吁阐明了政治必要性。如果遵守国际报告义务的国家继续承担不成比例的 67 成本,全球 暴发 通报系统的可信度可能会受到削弱。

papers.title: APC Injury: A Hypothesis That Dendritic-Cell Impairment Allows Persistent Viral Antigen and Loss of Self-Tolerance After Infection
papers.abstract: After an acute infection, the immune system can fail in two directions at once. It may fail to clear viral material that does not belong, allowing antigen or RNA to persist in tissue, and it may fail to tolerate self, producing autoantibodies. Failure to clear antigen is not the same as immunological tolerance of it. This article proposes that injury to antigen-presenting cells, chiefly dendritic cells (APC Injury), can help explain both failures after SARS-CoV-2. Acute COVID-19 commonly depletes circulating conventional and plasmacytoid dendritic cells. Remaining cells can be poor at co-stimulation or at producing interferon when challenged. After the acute illness, findings diverge: some long COVID cohorts show fewer cDC1s or more activated pDCs, others no major blood dendritic-cell depletion. Tissue studies show that altered dendritic-cell frequencies and retained viral antigen can coexist, but not that one causes the other. Autoantibodies appear in some assays and not in others. No published study has measured dendritic-cell function, tissue antigen, and self-antigen-specific regulatory T-cell or autoantibody outcomes in the same patients. Ebola virus can persist for months to years in privileged sites, and Ebola proteins can block dendritic-cell maturation in vitro. That analogy supports a testable model, not a proof in long COVID. A longitudinal study should measure dendritic-cell function, tissue viral material, and incident or changing autoreactivity in the same participants, with recovered controls, treating self-antigen-specific regulatory T-cell function as the mechanistic intermediate rather than as a substitute outcome. The model's central testable implication is temporal: a defined dendritic-cell functional defect should precede and predict both persistent antigen and new autoreactivity in the same people, rather than following either. A reduced residual association between the two outcomes after the defect and relevant common causes are accounted for would be consistent with the model, but would not uniquely identify it, because separate pathways with shared upstream causes can also produce correlated outcomes. No therapeutic claim follows until the affected subset, the impaired function, the tissue compartment, and the direction of correction have been identified.

papers.title_original: APC Injury: A Hypothesis That Dendritic-Cell Impairment Allows Persistent Viral Antigen and Loss of Self-Tolerance After Infection

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study addresses the dual failure of the immune system after acute infection, where it may fail to clear viral material and also fail to tolerate self-antigens, leading to autoantibody production. The article proposes a hypothesis that dendritic-cell impairment, termed APC Injury, could explain these failures in the context of SARS-CoV-2 infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a hypothesis-driven analysis proposing a model for understanding immune system failures after SARS-CoV-2 infection. It examines the potential role of dendritic-cell injury in both persistent viral antigen and loss of self-tolerance, focusing on human patients with long COVID and acute illness.
analysis.methods: The methods involve a theoretical framework based on existing evidence of dendritic-cell depletion and dysfunction in acute COVID-19, as well as in vitro studies showing how Ebola proteins can block dendritic-cell maturation. The study does not include direct experimental measurements but outlines a proposed model for further investigation.
analysis.main_results: The article reports that acute COVID-19 commonly depletes circulating conventional and plasmacytoid dendritic cells, and that remaining cells may be poor at co-stimulation or interferon production. It also notes that findings after acute illness vary, with some long COVID cohorts showing fewer cDC1s or more activated pDCs, while others show no major blood dendritic-cell depletion.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that dendritic-cell injury may explain both persistent viral antigen and loss of self-tolerance, but they emphasize that this is a hypothesis rather than a proven mechanism. The novelty lies in proposing a testable model that links dendritic-cell dysfunction to these outcomes in the same individuals.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that understanding dendritic-cell function could inform future studies on immune dysregulation in long COVID and other viral infections. This could have implications for developing targeted interventions to restore immune balance and prevent autoimmunity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to theoretical and observational data, with no direct experimental measurements of dendritic-cell function, tissue antigen, and autoreactivity in the same patients. The confidence in the hypothesis is moderate, as it relies on analogies and proposed models rather than definitive experimental results.

analysis.summary_en: This study proposes a hypothesis that dendritic-cell impairment, termed APC Injury, may explain the dual immune failures observed after SARS-CoV-2 infection: the persistence of viral antigen and the loss of self-tolerance. The authors note that acute COVID-19 often depletes dendritic cells, and remaining cells may be dysfunctional. They highlight that findings after acute illness vary, with some long COVID cohorts showing altered dendritic-cell frequencies and others not. The study emphasizes that no published research has measured dendritic-cell function, tissue viral material, and autoreactivity in the same patients. The hypothesis is supported by in vitro evidence from Ebola virus studies, but the authors caution that it remains a testable model rather than a proven mechanism. The findings suggest that understanding dendritic-cell dysfunction could inform future research on immune dysregulation in long COVID and other viral infections, though the evidence is limited and the confidence is moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究解决了急性感染后免疫系统的双重故障,即免疫系统可能无法清除病毒物质,也无法耐受自身抗原,从而导致自身抗体的产生。该文章提出了一个假设,即树突状细胞损伤(称为 APC 损伤)可以解释 SARS-CoV-2 感染背景下的这些失败。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项假设驱动的分析,提出了一个了解 SARS-CoV-2 感染后免疫系统故障的模型。它研究了树突状细胞损伤在持续性病毒抗原和自我耐受性丧失中的潜在作用,重点关注患有长期新冠病毒和急性疾病的人类患者。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及基于急性 COVID-19 树突状细胞耗竭和功能障碍的现有证据的理论框架,以及显示埃博拉蛋白如何阻止树突状细胞成熟的体外研究。该研究不包括直接的实验测量,但概述了供进一步研究的拟议模型。
elements_zh.main_results: 该文章报告说,急性 COVID-19 通常会耗尽循环的常规树突状细胞和浆细胞样树突状细胞,而剩余的细胞可能不善于共刺激或产生干扰素。它还指出,急性疾病后的结果各不相同,一些长期的 COVID 队列研究 显示较少的 cDC1 或更多的激活的 pDC,而其他人则没有显示出严重的血液树突状细胞耗竭。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,树突状细胞损伤可以解释持续的病毒抗原和自我耐受性的丧失,但他们强调这是一种假设,而不是经过证实的机制。新颖之处在于提出了一个可测试的模型,将树突状细胞功能障碍与同一个体的这些结果联系起来。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,了解树突状细胞的功能可以为未来关于长期新冠病毒和其他病毒感染中免疫失调的研究提供信息。这可能对制定有针对性的干预措施以恢复免疫平衡和预防自身免疫产生影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于理论和观察数据,没有对同一患者的树突状细胞功能、组织抗原和自身反应性进行直接实验测量。该假设的可信度中等,因为它依赖于类比和提出的模型,而不是明确的实验结果。

papers.abstract_zh: 急性感染后,免疫系统可能会同时向两个方向失效。它可能无法清除不属于的病毒物质,从而使抗原或RNA持续存在于组织中,并且它可能无法耐受自身,产生自身抗体。未能清除抗原并不等同于对其的免疫耐受。本文提出,抗原呈递细胞(主要是树突状细胞)的损伤(APC 损伤)有助于解释 SARS-CoV-2 后的这两种失败。急性 COVID-19 通常会消耗循环的常规树突状细胞和浆细胞样树突状细胞。其余细胞在受到挑战时可能不擅长共刺激或产生干扰素。急性疾病发生后,研究结果出现分歧:一些长期的 COVID 队列研究 显示出较少的 cDC1 或更多的激活的 pDC,而另一些则没有出现严重的血液树突状细胞耗竭。组织研究表明,改变的树突状细胞频率和保留的病毒抗原可以共存,但不是其中一种导致另一种。自身抗体出现在某些检测中,而在其他检测中则不出现。目前尚无已发表的研究测量同一患者的树突状细胞功能、组织抗原和自身抗原特异性调节性 T 细胞或自身抗体的结果。埃博拉病毒 可以在特殊部位持续数月至数年,而埃博拉蛋白可以在体外阻止树突状细胞的成熟。这个类比支持的是一个可测试的模型,而不是长期新冠病毒的证明。纵向研究应测量同一参与者的树突状细胞功能、组织病毒物质以及事件或变化的自身反应性,并恢复对照,将自身抗原特异性调节性 T 细胞功能视为机械中间体而不是替代结果。该模型的中心可测试含义是时间性的:确定的树突状细胞功能缺陷应该先于并预测同一个人的持久性抗原和新的自身反应性,而不是跟随其中任何一个。考虑缺陷和相关共同原因后,两个结果之间的残余关联性减少将与模型一致,但不能唯一地识别它,因为具有共享上游原因的单独路径也可以产生相关结果。在确定受影响的亚群、受损的功能、组织区室和纠正方向之前,不会提出任何治疗主张。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究解决了急性感染后免疫系统的双重故障,即免疫系统可能无法清除病毒物质,也无法耐受自身抗原,从而导致自身抗体的产生。该文章提出了一个假设,即树突状细胞损伤(称为 APC 损伤)可以解释 SARS-CoV-2 感染背景下的这些失败。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项假设驱动的分析,提出了一个了解 SARS-CoV-2 感染后免疫系统故障的模型。它研究了树突状细胞损伤在持续性病毒抗原和自我耐受性丧失中的潜在作用,重点关注患有长期新冠病毒和急性疾病的人类患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及基于急性 COVID-19 树突状细胞耗竭和功能障碍的现有证据的理论框架,以及显示埃博拉蛋白如何阻止树突状细胞成熟的体外研究。该研究不包括直接的实验测量,但概述了供进一步研究的拟议模型。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该文章报告说,急性 COVID-19 通常会耗尽循环的常规树突状细胞和浆细胞样树突状细胞,而剩余的细胞可能不善于共刺激或产生干扰素。它还指出,急性疾病后的结果各不相同,一些长期的 COVID 队列研究 显示较少的 cDC1 或更多的激活的 pDC,而其他人则没有显示出严重的血液树突状细胞耗竭。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,树突状细胞损伤可以解释持续的病毒抗原和自我耐受性的丧失,但他们强调这是一种假设,而不是经过证实的机制。新颖之处在于提出了一个可测试的模型,将树突状细胞功能障碍与同一个体的这些结果联系起来。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,了解树突状细胞的功能可以为未来关于长期新冠病毒和其他病毒感染中免疫失调的研究提供信息。这可能对制定有针对性的干预措施以恢复免疫平衡和预防自身免疫产生影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于理论和观察数据,没有对同一患者的树突状细胞功能、组织抗原和自身反应性进行直接实验测量。该假设的可信度中等,因为它依赖于类比和提出的模型,而不是明确的实验结果。

papers.title: Viral Pathogens as Global Health Threats: Review of Transmissibility, Lethality, and Pandemic Potential
papers.abstract: Viral pathogens vary substantially in their transmissibility, lethality, and potential to cause widespread epidemics or pandemics. Measles, for example, is exceptionally contagious but has relatively low case fatality in populations with access to modern medical care. Conversely, rabies, Nipah virus, Ebola virus, and Marburg virus can cause severe disease with high case fatality rates but generally exhibit limited sustained human-to-human transmission. The greatest global threats, therefore, are not necessarily the most contagious or lethal viruses, but those that combine efficient transmission, substantial clinical severity, zoonotic reservoirs, evolutionary adaptability, and limited preventive or therapeutic options. The COVID-19 pandemic illustrated this convergence of risk factors, demonstrating how efficient transmission, including presymptomatic and asymptomatic spread, coupled with clinically significant disease can produce devastating global consequences. Influenza A viruses remain a major pandemic concern because of their extensive animal reservoirs, capacity for antigenic evolution, and established history of human pandemics. Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) is particularly concerning given the high case fatality observed among confirmed human cases, although sustained human-to-human transmission has not been established. In contrast, henipaviruses and filoviruses pose substantial clinical threats because of their high lethality, despite comparatively limited transmissibility. This review critically examines major viral threats through three interconnected determinants of global health risk: transmissibility, infection fatality risk, and the biological and epidemiological factors governing their epidemic and pandemic potential.

papers.title: Short-term changes following Ebola prevention training among Chinese Nationals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a single-group pre–post evaluation
papers.abstract: Abstract Background During the 2026 outbreak of Ebola disease caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the 24th Chinese Medical Team to the DRC provided Ebola prevention training to Chinese nationals living or working in the country. This study evaluated short-term changes in Ebola-related knowledge, risk perception, psychological response, protective attitudes, and scenario-based protective behavioral intentions after training. Methods A single-group pre-post evaluation design was used. Five standardized in-person training sessions were combined with online electronic questionnaire assessments. The training covered Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission and exposure management, hand hygiene, and personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and included knowledge instruction, procedural demonstrations, and supervised PPE donning and doffing practice. Of 200 trainees, 190 completed both the pre- and post-training online questionnaires. Domain scores were compared using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, and item-level correct response rates were compared using McNemar tests with Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate adjustment. Results After training, the score distributions of all five domains changed significantly (all P Conclusions Short-term changes were observed in questionnaire-based Ebola prevention outcomes within 1 week after training. These findings do not establish causal effects of the training or changes in actual behavior or objectively assessed practical competence. Infectivity during the incubation period and contamination prevention during PPE doffing remain priorities for future training.
